puzzle.hint: One of Allah's Beautiful Names, meaning Most Generous and Noble — it follows 'Rabb' in a verse asking mankind what deceived them about their Lord
puzzle.arabicVerse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
puzzle.verse: 82:6 - O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
